details.description: DeepSeek-Coder-33B-Instruct is DeepSeek AI's instruction-tuned 33-billion-parameter code model, created by fine-tuning DeepSeek-Coder-Base 33B on 2 billion tokens of instruction data. It belongs to DeepSeek's original DeepSeek-Coder series (released November 2023, with a technical report following in January 2024), trained from scratch on 2 trillion tokens (87% code, 13% natural language in English and Chinese) with a 16K-token context window and support for 87 programming languages. DeepSeek's current API pricing page no longer lists any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model, so it is available only as open weights on Hugging Face or through third-party hosts.
advantages: Scores 79.3% pass@1 on DeepSeek's multilingual HumanEval Python benchmark and averages 69.2% across eight languages (Python, C++, Java, PHP, TypeScript, C#, Bash, JavaScript), per DeepSeek's technical report.
Scores 70.0% pass@1 on the MBPP benchmark, per DeepSeek's technical report.

Was the only open-source model in DeepSeek's LeetCode Contest comparison to outperform GPT-3.5-Turbo, scoring 27.8% overall pass@1 (28.9% with chain-of-thought prompting) versus GPT-3.5-Turbo's 23.3%, per DeepSeek's technical report.
Trained on 87 programming languages and supports project-level (cross-file) code completion with a 16K-token context window, per DeepSeek's model card.
disadvantages: DeepSeek's own current API pricing page no longer lists any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model; it is retired from DeepSeek's hosted platform and available only as open weights or via third-party hosts.
Still trails GPT-4-Turbo by a wide margin on DeepSeek's LeetCode Contest benchmark (28.9% vs. 41.8%, both with chain-of-thought prompting), per DeepSeek's technical report.
Natural-language training data covers only English and Chinese, per DeepSeek's model card.
use_cases: Code generation and multi-turn coding chat assistance

sources.title: DeepSeek-Coder: When the Large Language Model Meets Programming -- The Rise of Code Intelligence

notes: DeepSeek's current API pricing page (checked 2026-09-24) lists only deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro; DeepSeek-Coder v1/v1.5/V2 are absent, so this model is described as retired from DeepSeek's own platform though the weights and third-party hosting (e.g. Fireworks) remain. The paper's DS-1000 benchmark table covers only Base models, not this Instruct variant, so it is omitted from evaluations. Catalog facts (16384-token context, /v1/chat/completions endpoint) match Fireworks' model page. Verify pass: corrected the release date - the arXiv technical report (2401.14196) is dated January 2024, but the model repo itself (huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-33b-instruct) was created 2023-11-01 and the GitHub repo 2023-10-20, so the series' actual release was November 2023, not January 2024. No source states a formal 'deprecated' status for DeepSeek-Coder v1 (checked the API docs changelog/updates pages too); the description's 'no longer lists' framing is accurate and was kept as-is.
